statement: A verbatim copy of the Lane I envelope, taken from the controlling branch because data/rcap-grade-a/ is a captain-only path this lane may not edit and the envelope postdates this lane's base. The copy is not an authority; the captain's manifest is. Its provenance is recorded so the copy can be proved identical to its origin.

envelope.worktreeRule: One dedicated worktree per lane, created with git worktree add from the baseSha above, never shared with another lane and never the captain worktree at /home/user/legalease-partner-dashboard-clean.
envelope.requiredReturnFormat: Return the full 40-character commit SHA on the lane branch, the exact commands run, and their pass or fail result. The captain reviews and integrates the exact commit; do not open a pull request and do not request a branch merge.
requiredDeliverables: Select the highest-readiness route from the three integrated Oregon candidates and record the exact choice and why. Do not rebuild the Oregon overlay.

Close or precisely classify each of: packet-specification binding, source-provenance binding, provider and renderer identity, artifact-producing environment, final-verification contract, exact participant/matter binding, synthetic consumer payment, synthetic sponsored entitlement, one-credit generation, durable render, artifact validation, private Briefcase attachment, first download, repeat download, wrong-user denial, wrong-matter denial and substituted-artifact denial.

Prepare one exact approval packet for the authorized legal/output reviewer bound to route, specification hash, source hashes, artifact hash, candidate commit, page-by-page review and an exact requested approval statement.
Return the exact remaining owner decision rather than broad legal research.
envelope.requiredReturnCommit: not yet returned: the worker returns one exact 40-character commit SHA on claude/grade-a-v6-first-packet-oregon
dependencies: C: the integrated Oregon candidate evidence
H: security and the hosted runner
salvageBranches: no salvage branch exists for this lane; it starts fresh from the post-audit base
salvageCommits: no salvage commits: this lane has no prior pushed work to recover
stopConditions: Before any file is edited, the identity gate must establish all six of the following; if any one of them fails, return ENVIRONMENT MISROUTED without editing a file. (1) 148382ab2a2acbe673b6d35c8967f5a908342e60 exists as a commit in this clone. (2) `git merge-base --is-ancestor 148382ab2a2acbe673b6d35c8967f5a908342e60 origin/claude/legalease-sprint-captain-utucnw` exits zero, so the captain branch still contains this base. The captain tip may already be well ahead of it — every lane integrated after dispatch moves it — and the gate deliberately does not compare the two. (3) `git merge-base --is-ancestor 148382ab2a2acbe673b6d35c8967f5a908342e60 origin/claude/grade-a-v6-first-packet-oregon` exits zero, so this lane branch contains the base as an ancestor. (4) At worker start, nothing but this lane's own commits sits between 148382ab2a2acbe673b6d35c8967f5a908342e60 and the tip of origin/claude/grade-a-v6-first-packet-oregon. (5) `git status --porcelain` prints nothing, so the worker begins from a clean worktree. (6) `git remote get-url origin` names Roger-LegalEase/legalease-partner-dashboard-clean.
A change is required inside a captain-only path: stop and return a patch request; do not claim the path.
A required official source hash cannot be recomputed from the mounted corpus: stop rather than reading the hash back from a committed record.

Any Production deployment, migration, environment change, secret change, Stripe live-mode call, participant creation, sponsored-credit consumption or domain activation would be needed: stop and return the blocker.
A route appears to need commercial enabling: it does not. Commercially eligible is zero and every route is denied. Do not add an override, a bypass or a second commercial rule.
Output-level legal approval would have to be granted: stop. It is not a lane's to grant and not a captain's. Prepare the approval packet and return the exact owner decision.
Oregon would move out of the candidate area or into a production overlay: stop. It stays candidate-only until every gate passes.
